Building an open digital economy

A non-fungible token is a new kind of digital good: unique, provably scarce, and usable across many applications. Trade it freely, gift it, or resell it on an open marketplace, all with the programmability physical goods never had.

We back open standards like ERC-721 and ERC-1155 so creators can launch new digital works and developers can build integrated marketplaces on top of them.
